elements.name: Open the file menu while a part is active

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the user selects File
a menu opens with New, Open, Save, Save As, Export, Print and Close entries
the menu also shows Share, Manage and document properties entries
the command entries form a vertical list on the left
a recent-documents region is visible to the right of that list
some commands show disclosure indicators
application options and an exit control appear at the bottom of the menu
the model workspace remains visible behind the menu

elements.name: Dismiss the file menu with Escape

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the File menu is open
the user presses Escape
the File menu and recent-documents region close
the same part document remains active

elements.name: Dismiss the file menu by clicking outside

steps.name: an empty part document is active in the MCAD Software
the File menu is open
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the File menu and recent-documents region close
the same part document remains active

elements.name: Open and dismiss the file menu in a drawing

steps.name: a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software
the user selects File
the menu shows New, Open, Save, Save As, Export, Share, Manage, document properties, Print and Close entries
a recent-documents region is visible
the drawing sheet remains visible around the menu
the user presses Escape
the File menu closes
the same drawing document remains active

elements.name: Inspect controls in the recent-documents region

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are available
the user selects File
the recent-documents region shows an ordering control labeled By Ordered List
a separate display control is visible beside it
each visible recent-document row shows a document-type symbol and name on the left
each visible row shows a pin control on the right
the active part remains visible around the menu
the user presses Escape
the menu closes and the same part remains active

elements.name: Inspect the Save As submenu for a saved part

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open and saved in the MCAD Software
the user selects File
the user expands Save As
the submenu offers Save As and Save Copy As
it offers Save Copy As Template and Pack and Go
the Save Copy As description says the original file remains open

elements.name: Open the New submenu from the File menu

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the pointer is positioned over the New command location
the user presses Alt+F to open the File menu
the New submenu is displayed
the submenu describes creating a file from the available templates
it lists Assembly, Weldment, Drawing, Part, Sheet Metal and Presentation
Drawing displays a disclosure indicator
the active part remains visible behind the menu
no document type has been activated

elements.name: Inspect the File menu from Home

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` has been opened in the MCAD Software and is listed in recent documents
Home is active with at least one recent document visible
the user selects File
a vertical list of file commands opens over Home
a recent-documents region is shown beside the command list
Save As, document properties and Print appear muted
the Home recent-documents view remains visible around the menu
